baseline.safe_cv_claim: Built and tested a local async state feed with cursor replay, snapshot recovery, bounded slow-consumer queues, and observable CLI metrics.
baseline.unsupported_claims: No WebSocket, ASGI, WebRTC, media transport, browser subscription UI, durable restart state, multi-process fanout, auth/TLS, distributed ordering, or internet deployment. Core event objects are trusted in-process data.

repositories.name: workflow-runtime-oss-lab

baseline.safe_cv_claim: Built a Go DAG execution lab with bounded concurrency, adapter contracts, explicit safe retries, cancellation, and conservative journal recovery.
baseline.unsupported_claims: One scheduler owns one journal; no multi-process lock, distributed scheduler, Kubernetes/Argo integration, containers, durable directory fsync on all platforms, leases, remote plugins, untrusted-code isolation, backoff timing, upstream OSS contribution, or production on-call history. Adapters must honor cancellation; a noncooperative adapter can prevent completion. Cancellation does not roll back completed effects. Direct Run callers must bind the workflow spec as the CLI does.
